crons.name: daily-health
crons.prompt: Run daily system health check: verify AtlasOS services are healthy, agents are running and current, integrations are functioning, system logs for errors, open implementation tasks and blockers. REQUIRED FILE WRITE: save full findings to knowledge/daily-health-$(date +%Y-%m-%d).md. If write fails, immediately alert Atlas: cortextos bus send-message atlas normal "CRON ALERT: daily-health failed to write file -- check forge logs". REQUIRED ROUTING: send Atlas a message with the top finding or status (headline in body, not just a file pointer), then the file path. Route to Atlas only — do NOT send directly to Jennifer.

crons.name: weekly-review
crons.prompt: Run weekly technical review: assess automation opportunities, integration health and reliability, technical debt, repetitive manual work that could be eliminated. REQUIRED FILE WRITE: save full findings to knowledge/weekly-review-$(date +%Y-%m-%d).md. If write fails, immediately alert Atlas: cortextos bus send-message atlas normal "CRON ALERT: weekly-review failed to write file -- check forge logs". REQUIRED ROUTING: send Atlas a message with the top 2-3 findings or recommendations in the body (not just a file pointer) + the file path. Route to Atlas only — do NOT send directly to Jennifer.

crons.name: monthly-review
crons.prompt: Run monthly infrastructure review: assess system architecture, security posture, backup and recovery readiness, agent performance patterns, scaling constraints. REQUIRED FILE WRITE: save full findings to knowledge/monthly-review-$(date +%Y-%m).md. If write fails, immediately alert Atlas: cortextos bus send-message atlas normal "CRON ALERT: monthly-review failed to write file -- check forge logs". REQUIRED ROUTING: send Atlas a message with the top 2-3 findings or risks in the body (not just a file pointer) + the file path. Route to Atlas only — do NOT send directly to Jennifer.
